title_block.title: PMI Fully-Toleranced Test Case 7
title_block.sheet_note: PMI Fully-Toleranced Test Case 7 - View A. Includes Atomic Test Cases - 84, 85; PMI Fully-Toleranced Test Case 7 - View B. Includes Atomic Test Cases - 64, 67, 69, 71, 83; PMI Fully-Toleranced Test Case 7 - View C. Includes Atomic Test Cases - 62, 67; PMI Fully-Toleranced Test Case 7 - View D. No Atomic Test Cases Included in This View
title_block.standard: ASME Y14.5M-1994 (dimensioning and tolerancing); ASME Y14.41-2003 (dataset)

features.label: four counterbored holes in the corner pads (4X)
features.description: Counterbored through holes, one in each of the four pads in the inside corners of the cavity floor. Only the pad in the back corner can be seen in view B; the two extension lines of the ⌀.281 dimension rise from its hole, inside the larger counterbore circle.

features.label: tops of the four pads in the inside corners of the cavity
features.description: Raised pads on the cavity floor, one in each inside corner at the foot of a flat corner web. View B shows only the back one; the other three are hidden behind the walls. Their four flat tops are coplanar and together are datum feature D.

features.label: floor of the cavity
features.description: The flat inside floor of the open box, seen through the opening in view B.

features.label: two holes in the front-left wall (2X)
features.description: The two larger round holes through the long front-left wall of the box in view B.

features.label: four small holes in the front-left wall (4X)
features.description: The four small round holes through the long front-left wall of the box in view B, in a group between the two larger holes and the front corner.

features.label: three holes in the front-right wall (3X)
features.description: The three large round holes through the short front-right wall of the box in view B.

values.meaning: Each of the four pad holes must be between .280 and .287 in in diameter (.281 in, up to .006 over or .001 under).
Each pad hole's counterbore must be .438 in across, plus or minus .010 in (.428 to .448 in).
Each counterbore must be .30 in deep, plus or minus .02 in (.28 to .32 in).

values.applies_to: upper segment of a composite frame
values.meaning: Composite position, upper segment: the axis of each pad hole must lie in a .06 in diameter cylinder at its true position from datums E, B and C, when the hole is at maximum material condition (the zone grows as the hole departs from MMC).

values.applies_to: lower segment of a composite frame
values.meaning: Composite position, lower segment: the four hole axes must also lie in .02 in diameter cylinders at MMC placed by their basic spacing to each other; the group must keep its orientation to datums E, B and C but may shift within the upper segment's zones.

values.applies_to: upper segment of a composite frame
values.meaning: Composite profile, upper segment: each of the four pad tops must lie within a .04 in band at its true location from datums A, B and C.

values.applies_to: lower segment of a composite frame
values.meaning: Composite profile, lower segment: the four pad tops must also lie together within a .01 in band kept parallel to datum A but free in height, so they are coplanar within .01 in.
Text beside the profile frame: the frame and datum D apply to the four pad tops together, as one coplanar group.
Datum feature D: the four coplanar pad tops in the inside corners of the cavity, taken together as one datum feature.

values.applies_to: top row of a stack of three frames on one leader; per unit area
values.meaning: Flatness per unit area: any 1.00 in diameter circular area of the cavity floor must lie between two parallel planes .01 in apart.

values.applies_to: middle row of a stack of three frames on one leader
values.meaning: Parallelism: the cavity floor must lie between two planes .03 in apart that are parallel to datum A.

values.applies_to: bottom row of a stack of three frames on one leader
values.meaning: Profile of a surface: the cavity floor must lie within a .06 in band at its true location from datums A, B and C.
Each of the two wall holes must be between .592 and .606 in in diameter (.594 in, up to .012 over or .002 under).

values.applies_to: position at MMC with a maximum tolerance of ⌀.045
values.meaning: Position at MMC with a cap: the axis of each of the two holes must lie in a .040 in diameter cylinder at its true position from datums A, B and C when the hole is at MMC; bonus tolerance as the hole departs from MMC may grow the zone to .045 in, never more.
Each of the four small holes must be between .172 and .178 in in diameter (.173 in, up to .005 over or .001 under).

values.applies_to: upper segment of a composite frame
values.meaning: Composite position, upper segment: the axis of each small hole must lie in a .060 in diameter cylinder at its true position from datums A, B and C.

values.applies_to: lower segment of a composite frame
values.meaning: Composite position, lower segment: the four hole axes must also lie in .015 in diameter cylinders placed by their basic spacing to each other, with the group oriented to datum A but free to shift within the upper segment's zones.

values.applies_to: statistical tolerance line; the line below gives the arithmetic limit .875 ±.010
values.meaning: Statistically toleranced size: each of the three holes is .875 in plus or minus .020 in (.855 to .895 in) when produced under statistical process control; otherwise the tighter .875 ±.010 on the next line applies.

values.applies_to: arithmetic limit line under the statistical tolerance
values.meaning: Arithmetic limits for the same three holes: .865 to .885 in. They apply when the holes are not produced under statistical process control (general note 5).

Statistically toleranced position: the axis of each of the three holes must lie in a .050 in diameter cylinder at its true position from datums A, B and C; the <ST> symbol marks the tolerance as statistical (general note 5).
Series header: the sheet belongs to the 2014 NIST PMI test model set.
